    'yellowtail_kept': 'sum',
    'yellowtail_released': 'sum',
    'trip_id': 'count',
    'angler_count': 'mean'
}).rename(columns={'trip_id': 'trip_count'})

doy_summary['yt_per_angler'] = doy_summary['yt_total'] / (doy_summary['trip_count'] * doy_summary['angler_count'])

# Show recent doys (90-125)
print("Season 2 YT by DOY (doy 90-125):")
print(doy_summary.loc[90:125, ['trip_count', 'yt_total', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

trips = tables['trips']

# Get full year data for both seasons
s1_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 1]
s2_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 2]

# For each season, show which doys had the most yt/angler
s1_doy_summary = s1_trips.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': lambda x: x.count()
}).rename(columns={'anglers': 'trip_count'})
s1_doy_summary['total_anglers'] = s1_trips.groupby('fish_date_doy')['anglers'].sum()
s1_doy_summary['yt_per_angler'] = s1_doy_summary['yt'] / s1_doy_summary['total_anglers']

s2_doy_summary = s2_trips.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': lambda x: x.count()
}).rename(columns={'anglers': 'trip_count'})
s2_doy_summary['total_anglers'] = s2_trips.groupby('fish_date_doy')['anglers'].sum()
s2_doy_summary['yt_per_angler'] = s2_doy_summary['yt'] / s2_doy_summary['total_anglers']

print("Season 1 - Top 10 DOYs by yt/angler (peak fishing windows):")
s1_top = s1_doy_summary.nlargest(10, 'yt_per_angler')
print(s1_top[['trip_count', 'yt', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

print("\n\nSeason 2 - Top 10 DOYs by yt/angler (available so far, day 121):")
s2_top = s2_doy_summary.nlargest(10, 'yt_per_angler')
print(s2_top[['trip_count', 'yt', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

print("\n\nSeason 2 - All doys with >0.5 yt/angler:")
s2_high = s2_doy_summary[s2_doy_summary['yt_per_angler'] > 0.5].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(s2_high[['trip_count', 'yt', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())
